title: TS SDK: runtime discriminator helpers, Zod/JSON-Schema adapters, and streaming-safe validators
creator: Maria Chen
comments: 2026-02-16 - Alex Johnson: Prototype of matchDiscriminatorPartial in PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-ts/pull/412. Early perf numbers look promising (2-3x faster path selection on typical chats).

2026-02-20 - Design review (Maria): Confirmed naming conventions and proposed `@tag` pragma. Added note to docs about explicit vs heuristic discriminators. Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SDK/TypeGen+Discriminator+Design

2026-02-25 - QA (Samira Patel): Found edge-case where streaming chunk split inside unicode escape causes false-negative in partial matcher. Added unit test and fixed algorithm to be UTF-8-aware. GitHub issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-ts/issues/439
2026-03-03 - Performance (Jorge): Bundle-size test added in CI; initial delta +0.7% after strip helper. Next we should evaluate tree-shaking in downstream apps.

2026-03-09 - PM (Rina Gupta): Approved feature flag rollout plan. Customer impact: medium; docs and migration guide required before default-on. Linked PR for migration guide: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/89
